{{Top|leg}}
'''Vaporers''' were [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] warriors on their homeplanet of [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]]. For the most part, Clawdite society was held together as an orderly anarchy, with vaporers attracting followers under a multitude of different banners. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the feud between the Clawdites and the [[Zolander]]s came to a head. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent diplomats to the planet to negotiate a settlement between the warring sides. However, with the assassination of the New Republic's chief negotiator by a Zolander rabble-rouser, civil war broke out as the most powerful vaporers declared war against their Zolander brothers. The vaporer [[Renneyn]] spearheaded attacks that led to Clawdite control of three-quarters of the planet, including Zolan's capital city.<ref name="Standoff on Leritor">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref>
